svg.title: Jobs with the class right: posted comments against the rule
svg.desc: On 128 jobs whose labels a model set, most of them with hindsight, the rule had the class right on 93 against 66 for the posted comments; on three checks that do not depend on those labels the lead is gone: 20 for the rule against 19 for a replay of production on 35 gold jobs, 16 against 20 saying infrastructure on the 50 that passed on a rerun, and 10 against 9 on the 14 with a bug reference from a reviewer.

g.text: The 128 jobs, by class of the label
Every label here was set by a model, most with hindsight.
